name: Facet
text: Ship EXCAVA with a dark theme by default but auto-switch to light mode when the system detects high ambient light. This keeps eye strain low in dim rooms while ensuring readability in bright spaces—no manual toggling needed. The trade-off is slightly higher dev effort to implement the light sensor logic, but it directly improves liveliness and clarity for users.

name: Pane
text: The real risk isn’t user preference—it’s that auto-switching still assumes users *want* their interface to change without their say. A better alternative: ship a one-click toggle that remembers the user’s choice, with the system defaulting to dark but letting them override it permanently. Settle it by testing both options with five users—if more than half manually switch back within a day, the toggle wins.
